description: This file defines URL patterns for the leads module in a Django project, mapping specific URL routes to corresponding view classes related to lead management, including creation, listing, detail view, attachments, comments, and pipeline operations.

classes.name: CreateLeadFromSite
classes.description: View class handling creation of leads from external site submissions.

classes.name: LeadAttachmentView
classes.description: View class for handling lead attachment operations.

classes.name: LeadCommentView
classes.description: View class for handling comments on leads.

classes.name: LeadUploadView
classes.description: View class for uploading bulk lead data.

classes.name: LeadDetailView
classes.description: View class for retrieving and updating lead details.

classes.name: LeadKanbanView
classes.description: View class providing Kanban board representation for leads.

classes.name: LeadMoveView
classes.description: View class for moving leads between stages or pipelines.

classes.name: LeadPipelineListCreateView
classes.description: View class for listing and creating pipelines.

classes.name: LeadPipelineDetailView
classes.description: View class for specific pipeline details.

classes.name: LeadStageCreateView
classes.description: View class for creating new stages within a pipeline.

classes.name: LeadStageDetailView
classes.description: View class for retrieving and updating a stage.

classes.name: LeadStageReorderView
classes.description: View class for reordering stages within a pipeline.

methods.name: as_view
methods.description: Django method to convert class-based views into callable view functions.
